meta.name: Emergent harvest: ego cruises a multilane corridor in dense ambient traffic
meta.description: World scaffolding for emergence harvesting (rethink stream C). Ego cruises a multi-lane (>=2 same-direction) corridor with NO scripted challenger; dense heterogeneous ambient population supplies all other motion. Because ambient candidates are structurally excluded from the ego's own lanes (authored-corridor reservation, traffic.ts), ego-involved events here are limited to adjacent/crossing geometry; the template's main harvest value is ambient-to-ambient merge/queue events for the taxonomy, at low cost. Clip 16 s.
